groups.name: Canadian provinces
groups.fact: Canada has ten provinces and three territories.

groups.name: Australian states
groups.fact: Australia has six states, and Tasmania is the only one that is an island.

groups.name: Famous wine regions
groups.fact: Under European rules, only sparkling wine from Champagne can be called Champagne.

groups.name: Regions split by a national border
groups.fact: Tyrol was split between Austria and Italy after World War I, and South Tyrol is still mostly German-speaking.
